create_numel_dataset: create a NumelDataset wrapping an existing dataset to return element counts per item
use_getitem_numel: use NumelDataset getitem to get the number of elements in a tensor or numpy array item
use_collater_reduce: use the collater method with reduce=True to sum element counts across a batch of samples
use_collater_tensor: use the collater method with reduce=False to return element counts as a torch tensor
